text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.KhyQ0Kbn9XnUi9U6]{08. The Lightwardens}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.rA5OyJGxJB0eSNpV]{Radiant Warden (Dormant)}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.Wh0UoANuOMtToLgL]{Radiant Warden (Active)}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.sRc0hJQFnVsUfYos]{Hull Defence Grid}

Zone Zone 17: Numeria (hillside with a buried hull)
Hex 2.2 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Combat + puzzle/hazard
Threat Moderate 100 XP at party level 16
Creatures 1 Numerian radiant warden (level 17, Kingmaker) + hull defence grid (complex hazard 16, 40 XP)

Irovetti's map note. A small wedge drawn in silver ink with three concentric rings around it and "unopened — buyers in Starfall."

Background. A wedge of starship hull broke off during the Rain of Stars and buried itself in this hillside. The radiant warden is one of its maintenance constructs. It still guards the sealed hatch and still runs the hull's defence grid. Irovetti bought the location from a Numerian scavenger and planned to sell the contents to buyers in Starfall. His expedition never got past the grid.

Arrival.

A curve of silvery metal juts from the hillside like the blade of a vast axe, smooth and unmarked by ten thousand years of weather. In the grass below it stands a strange device of brass rings and glass lenses, slowly turning as though tracking the stars. Lines of pale light pulse along seams in the hull.

Features.

  • Orrery. Until it acts, the radiant warden looks like a stationary mechanical orrery (Orrery ability).
  • Pylons. Three emitter pylons in an arc in front of the hull; they are the defence grid's sections.
  • Scorched ground. A ring of glassy earth around the hull marks the grid's kill zone. Bones and broken Pitaxian gear lie in it.
  • Hatch. A circular seal on the hull's flank. It opens with a DC 38 Thievery check or a DC 38 Crafting check to bypass, or automatically if the PCs disable all three pylons.

HULL DEFENCE GRID — HAZARD 16 Complex, Electricity, Fire, Mechanical, Trap Stealth +30 (expert); DC 38 to notice the pylons' tracking lenses before entering the scorched ring Description Three pylons fire laser bursts at intruders inside the scorched ring. Disable DC 38 Thievery or DC 40 Crafting to disable one pylon; a DC 36 Society or Crafting check to read the hull's glyphs reduces the remaining pylons' Disable DCs by 2. AC 39; Fort +30, Ref +24 Pylon Hardness 20; Pylon HP 80 (BT 40); Immunities critical hits, object immunities, precision damage Lock-On ↺ Trigger A creature enters the scorched ring. Effect The grid rolls initiative. Routine (one action per working pylon) Each working pylon fires a laser at a random creature in the ring: Ranged laser +31, Damage 4d10+14 fire. On a critical hit the target is also dazzled until the end of its next turn. Reset The grid resets 1 hour after no creatures remain in the ring.

Running the encounter.

  • The warden activates when anyone enters the scorched ring or touches the hatch. It opens with Radiant Blast on the largest group, then hammers the nearest PC; Radiant Blow anchors them inside the ring for the pylons.
  • Its Gatekeeper Aura reroutes teleports back to the centre of the ring.
  • Each turn a PC spends on the pylons is a turn the warden gets free attacks. A PC who reads the glyphs (Society or Crafting, DC 36) learns that disabling the pylons also opens the hatch, and that the warden shuts down if the hatch opens: the warden's orders are to guard a sealed hull.
  • Numerian rule. The warden has weakness 15 to critical hits and electricity per the Zone 17 note.

Outcomes.

  • Warden destroyed. The grid keeps firing until disabled.
  • Hatch opened first. The warden powers down. Its core can be salvaged.
  • Retreat. The grid resets. The warden returns to its orrery disguise.

Rewards. 100 XP. Treasure inside the hull: a skymetal cache (orichalcum or adamantine stock worth 2,000 gp), a level 17 permanent item reflavoured as Numerian tech, and two consumables of level 15–16. A salvaged warden core is worth 1,500 gp to Numerian buyers or serves as a kingdom curiosity.

Scaling. At party level 18, add a second radiant warden. For a weaker party, run the grid with two pylons.
